## Quarterly Reflections {#reflections}

Each quarter, a member of the IDSWG community contributes a short piece on the group's history, its people, or a moment that shaped its direction. Together these build a living record of where the group came from and why its work matters.

:::{#history-listing}
:::

:::

```{=html}
<div class="content-section-alt">
<div class="inner">
<h2 class="section-title" id="milestones">Milestones</h2>
<p>Key moments in the group's history. This timeline is being expanded.</p>

<div class="timeline">
  <div class="timeline-item">
    <div class="timeline-dot major"></div>
    <div class="timeline-year">2015</div>
    <div class="timeline-title">Group Founded</div>
    <p class="timeline-desc">The Innovative Design Scientific Working Group is established, and the KOL Lecture Series begins its monthly webinars on innovative trial design.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline-item">
    <div class="timeline-dot"></div>
    <div class="timeline-year">2020</div>
    <div class="timeline-title">First NEED Publication; Randomization WG Launches</div>
    <p class="timeline-desc">The NEED sub-team publishes its roadmap for using historical controls, and the Randomization Working Group launches as a joint initiative.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline-item">
    <div class="timeline-dot major"></div>
    <div class="timeline-year">2022</div>
    <div class="timeline-title">Platform Trials Book; Transition to DahShu</div>
    <p class="timeline-desc"><em>Platform Trials in Drug Development</em> is published, and the group transitions to operating under the DahShu umbrella.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline-item">
    <div class="timeline-dot"></div>
    <div class="timeline-year">2023</div>
    <div class="timeline-title">Master Protocol Working Group Formed</div>
    <p class="timeline-desc">The ASA-DahShu IDSWG Master Protocol Working Group is formally constituted as a joint effort with ASA and BSWG.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline-item">
    <div class="timeline-dot major"></div>
    <div class="timeline-year">2025</div>
    <div class="timeline-title">Awards, Publications, and Growth</div>
    <p class="timeline-desc">The Randomization WG is named PSI SIG of the Year. The NEED sub-team publishes its cell and gene therapy paper. Membership reaches approximately 200, and the group launches its first website.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#666;margin-top:1rem;">For the full record of publications and presentations, see the <a href="../publications.qmd">Publications</a> page.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="content-section" style="max-width:1020px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 2.5rem;">
```
